# CueFinder — Search like a supervisor thinks. (for AI agents)

Natural-language sync search over the 24-track That Boy Hi Hat catalog: moods, BPM, instrumentation, scenes, use cases — with transparent match explanations and a DIRECT CLEARANCE badge on every result.

Live: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-cuefinder/
Operator: Cumulative Web Inc (Agent Deck SKU #40)

## Machine-readable

- `agent_card`: .well-known/agent-card.json
- `brief_packs`: v1/brief-packs (5 machine-readable sync brief packs)
- `discovery_note`: discovery.txt
- `embed`: embed.html
- `sync_catalog`: sync-catalog.json
- `sync_catalog_v1`: v1/sync-catalog.json

## Honest limits

Editorial descriptors are curation, never audio analysis. Every BPM is an estimate, labeled est. Rights: no one-stop or pre-cleared claims — clearance is direct via hp@cumulativeweb.com.

## Use it

Describe the scene — mood, energy, BPM, instruments. Every result shows exactly why it matched. Rights: direct clearance via hp@cumulativeweb.com (no one-stop / pre-cleared claims).

Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com · Source: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-cuefinder
